materials.notes: Ea in low-T range (350-450 C) = 1.04 eV; high-T range (450-600 C) recorded = 0.53 eV. Crystallite 36 nm, lattice 5.446 A, band gap 2.9 eV. R1 = 1.6 Ohm, C = 1.99e-8 F. extraction_notes: Seven electrolyte compositions varying only in the alkali-carbonate second phase (single/binary/ternary); all share SDC = Ce0.8Sm0.2O2-delta host with 1:2 SDC:carbonate molar ratio, co-precipitation/oxalate synthesis, and 800 C 4 h calcination. Conductivity measured 4-probe DC in H2/O2 (350-600 C); fuel cell tested in H2/air at 600 C with LiNiCuZn-oxide electrodes. Ea reported in two temperature ranges (350-450 C and 450-600 C); the schema single-value activation_energy_eV holds the high-T value (450-600 C) as it is the operating range; the low-T value is noted per material. Individual carbonate ratios within binary and ternary mixtures are not stated in the extracted text. Relative density and durability hours not reported.
